summary_1line: Nakula asks Bhishma whether the sword or bow is supreme; Bhishma begins a mythic account of the sword’s divine origin from Brahma’s sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: From a blazing sacrificial fire on a Himalayan altar, a dark radiant being emerges as the earth trembles and meteors streak across the sky.
The being transforms into a brilliant sword which Brahma hands to the blue‑throated Rudra.
Rudra with four arms and a third eye whirls the shining sword beneath the sun, flames issuing from his mouth as the gods watch.
